ideas.idea: Make /guides real content: list routes with grade, distance and time, each on its own /guides/<slug> page
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but lists none, so adding real content gives crawlers and readers something to understand.

ideas.idea: Add substance to the home page: intro, featured walks, location
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so there is little text to explain the site.

ideas.idea: Add canonical URLs once the real domain is known
ideas.why: No canonical exists anywhere and the sitemap uses a placeholder domain, so declaring one would help consolidate URLs.

ideas.idea: Replace the placeholder trailhead.example domain in the sitemap with the real domain
ideas.why: The sitemap's loc entries use a placeholder domain that would point crawlers to wrong URLs.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD for site identity
ideas.why: It is accurate but applies to almost any site and is likely to have little effect on a two-page site.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: It is accurate but of marginal value for a tiny sitemap, and the report itself hedges it.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with a Nuxt sitemap module instead of by hand
ideas.why: It is sensible but of little effect for a two-route site and applies to any Nuxt project.

ideas.idea: Remove the noindex header from /guides or restrict it to /admin, and fix the sitemap listing a noindex page
ideas.why: It repeats the known noindex-on-/guides problem, so it isn't a separate recommendation.
